summary: The CI evidence signing helper lets a step-based job record extra named inputs (a shard, a test set), and the linux-gate aggregate note ignores the jobs of the separate fractal-web lane

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change; one CI helper script and its test.

schema.detail: No schema change. Extra inputs are named strings in the existing open inputs map of a note.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change. Nothing is skipped; no workflow uses the new input yet.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or harness contract change. A job that sets no STEP_INPUTS behaves as before; a malformed STEP_INPUTS or one that replaces a fixed input makes no note, like every other refusal.

recovery.detail: Revert this change; notes already signed stay valid.
